jobs.title: Real Estate Transaction Lead, EMEA
jobs.description: Mission Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear. In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives. Role Purpose We are looking for a driven, transaction-focused real estate professional to own deal execution across the EMEA region. You will be part of a lean, high-velocity expansion team reporting directly to the Director of Real Estate. This is not a support role. You will run site selection, lead LOI negotiations, manage broker relationships, and drive leases to execution across a growing portfolio of healthcare retail clinics in your markets. Neko is opening clinics at pace: the plan moves from a handful of sites today to a 2028 cohort in the dozens across EMEA and a global portfolio in the hundreds by 2030. Most in-house real estate roles at this scale sit inside large corporate structures where deals move slowly and decisions need layers of approval. Here, your deals matter immediately, your judgment is trusted, and the decisions you make in year one will shape the portfolio for the next decade. The team is small and growing quickly, built around regional Transaction Leads covering the West, East, and Central United States and EMEA, supported by national specialists in market analysis, deal support, and lease administration. Many of these seats are still being filled, so you will help set the standard rather than inherit one. jobs.title: Senior Vascular Sonographer
jobs.description: Mission Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear. In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives. Role Purpose We are growing our vascular team and building out the follow-up pathway that sits behind the Neko Body Scan. When a scan raises a vascular flag, such as a low ankle-brachial index, a difference in blood pressure between the arms, or asymmetry on our Spectrum Gen 2 imaging, a member is referred for a follow-up examination. You will carry out those examinations. This is a senior role within a small, close team. You will scan and report your findings, work closely with our Vascular Specialist, who makes the clinical decisions and referrals, and help shape how the pathway runs as it scales. You will also be a vascular reference point for the doctors and operators who perform first-line measurements in our clinics. What you will do Perform and report arterial duplex ultrasound of the lower and upper limbs for members referred through the vascular follow-up pathway. Carry out repeat ankle-brachial pressure index (ABPI) with Doppler, and toe pressures or toe-brachial index where the pathway calls for them. Carry out the examination requested through the pathway, record your findings clearly and consistently, and report them to the Vascular Specialist, who decides the outcome and any onward referral. jobs.title: RWE Biostatistician
jobs.description: 🏨 The company Resilience Care is a leading French remote patient monitoring (RPM) company and a clinical research partner, founded in 2021 with a mission: better care. We provide RPM solutions in oncology, gastroenterology and psychiatry, combining ePRO collection with AI techniques. Our platform supports healthcare professionals with early side‑effect detection for continuous and proactive care, and our patient mobile app helps measure and manage symptoms with tailored resources. Our solutions improve care pathways, enrich continuous patient understanding, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring and in‑depth analysis of real‑world data. They are currently deployed in routine care for 35,000 patients across 200+ healthcare institutions, and also support around twenty academic and industry clinical studies. We put data at the service of care and therapeutic innovation, with the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine. 📝 Your role In a nutshell : you will help build and deliver robust statistical work for Real‑World Evidence (RWE) and Medical Affairs studies — from analysis planning (SAP) to reproducible programming and clear interpretation. Your impact : make study execution more reliable, faster and more reproducible (plans, code and reporting), enabling cross‑functional teams to make informed decisions. Your day‑to‑day Draft and/or contribute to Statistical Analysis Plans (SAP) and methodological documentation. Program analyses in R and Python; concept of SQL/Postgre. Contribute to RWE studies : design, methods and execution. Set up data quality checks (consistency, cohort rules) and document assumptions. Produce decision‑ready deliverables (tables/figures/reporting) and explain results to non‑statisticians (internal or external actors). ✨ Your team Your future teammates : Dynamic team with medical and pharma expertise Your manager : Nicoleta - Director Translational Research – RWE & Biostatistics 👤 Pro

jobs.title: People Associate (internship)
jobs.description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. People operations — get hands-on with the fundamentals of HR and be the first point of contact for Alaners navigating day-to-day requests. Individual situations — shadow, then gradually own simple individual situations, learning how to guide leads and coaches through sensitive conversations with care and structure. jobs.title: VP of Clinical Services and Executive Medical Director
jobs.description: About Solace Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes. We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly. Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way. Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement here . About the Role Solace’s physicians perform a critical function, performing initial assessments, establishing relationships with our patients and acting as the entry point for Solace’s advocate services, and collaborating with the advocate team to ensure patients’ health and wellness goals are met. We’re looking for a VP, Clinical Services and Executive Medical Director to lead and scale an expanding physician group at a rapidly growing company. Reporting to the Chief Medical Officer, this role serves as the principal operational physician executive responsible for the day-to-day clinical leadership of a telehealth physician workforce. This role will own performance management of the physician group, ensure an exemplary patient experience is provided and high quality and efficient clinical care is performed, and build the systems, governance structures, and team capabilities required to sustain those standards as the company grows. jobs.description: General Summary The temporary Clinical Data Manager acts as a lead data manager for one or more projects, applies data management experience to clinical trials, and utilizes functional knowledge of the logistics of clinical trials to ensure the quality and integrity of clinical trial data. The CDM works on multi-functional teams and supports clinical trial projects as a departmental subject matter expert (SME). We are seeking a temporary clinical data manager who can dedicate 20 hours a week to support ongoing study activities. The initial assignment is for 6 months, but may be extended to meet the needs of our Team. Applicants must be eligible to live and work in the US.
